title: Air France v Folkerts (Case C-11/11), 26 February 2013
source: Air France v Folkerts (Case C-11/11), 26 February 2013
excerpt: compensation is payable, on the basis of that article, to a passenger on directly connecting flights who has been delayed at departure for a period below the limits specified in Article 6 of that regulation, but has arrived at the final destination at least three hours later than the scheduled arrival time,
summary: For directly connecting flights, the delay that counts is the delay at the final destination, even if the departure delay was short.
